phase_5.degraded_rationale: The rubric's 5.1 exit path is explicit: when no genuinely separate model is reachable, record NONE_AVAILABLE and do not simulate its output. No second LLM score was invented and no agreement metric is reported as if it had been measured. Instead of a simulated peer, a MECHANICAL validator was run: an independent re-implementation of the arithmetic that re-derives every penalty term from the raw severity/confidence/grade triple, re-sums R_point from the published per-dimension scores, re-applies the hard gates, re-runs the Monte Carlo from the published bands and re-opens a seeded 10-token evidence sample by reading the cited file ranges. That checks arithmetic and citation, not judgement, and the gap is stated plainly.

R_point re-summed from the published dimension scores
hard gates re-derived from the published counts and journey verdicts
Monte Carlo re-run from the published bands (mean drift tolerance 0.30)

freeze_exceptions.issue: F-EXEC-001's arithmetic was corrected after the Phase 5 freeze.
freeze_exceptions.detail: Phase 2 estimated the client gap as '13 of the 18 authenticated MVP routes'. Task T-007 then produced a machine-counted census (docs/GO_60_ROADMAP.md:47-90) showing 27 routes, 4 public, 23 bearer-authenticated and 4 genuinely wired (the fifth candidate was a substring false positive on the POST /v1/orders call site). The finding text and its evidence were corrected to '4 of 23 wired, 19 unwired'.
freeze_exceptions.direction: The correction makes the finding STRONGER, not weaker, so it cannot have been trimming to reach a verdict.
freeze_exceptions.validator_acknowledgement: NONE_AVAILABLE — no independent validator exists in this environment; recorded as unacknowledged.

freeze_exceptions.issue: audit_confidence_pct is 95.1 in the re-scored artifacts but was 93.62 at the Phase 5 freeze.
freeze_exceptions.detail: At freeze time the coverage_ratio input was an estimate over the files read during Phases 0-2. The Phase 7 inventory closed with a machine-built inspected-file list (harness/inventory_extra.json, 92 files, coverage_ratio 0.902), which raised the deterministic confidence product to 95.1. No finding, severity, weight, cap or R_point value changed; the engine is re-run from the same frozen inputs.
freeze_exceptions.direction: Evidence coverage rose because more files were actually inspected; the change is a measurement correction, not a scoring adjustment.
freeze_exceptions.validator_acknowledgement: NONE_AVAILABLE — no independent validator exists in this environment; recorded as unacknowledged.

freeze_exceptions.issue: Four evidence citations were corrected after the merge, when the strengthened content check began sampling cmd# tokens and re-checked every range against the shipped tree.
freeze_exceptions.detail: (1) F-OPS-003 cited render.yaml:3-10 (a service header) for an ABSENCE claim; replaced with a recorded grep, cmd#35, plus the Dockerfile read that shows what is hardened. (2) F-LEGAL-001 cited docs/GO_NO_GO.md:47-51, which does not mention legal approval; the unsigned-draft statement is at 34-35. (3) F-API-001 cited TamirkarRepository.kt:80-84, which stops five lines short of the `dev_` minting line at 89. (4) F-DATA-002 cites two facets of one claim, so its escrow-worker citation now carries its own per-token anchor.
freeze_exceptions.direction: No severity, confidence, evidence grade, weight or score changed — verified by re-running emit/emit-after, which reproduce R_point 79.073 and 80.9198 exactly. Every correction makes the evidence behind a finding easier to verify, not the finding weaker.
freeze_exceptions.validator_acknowledgement: NONE_AVAILABLE — no independent validator exists in this environment; the corrections were instead forced by the mechanical content check.

freeze_exceptions.issue: The evidence checker itself was strengthened, which changes what the certificate claims.
freeze_exceptions.detail: Four defects in the checker were found and fixed at the merge: (a) only `path:lo-hi` tokens parsed, so the three single-line tokens raised ValueError; (b) `cmd#N` tokens were accepted without ever resolving the number (now they must exist in the evidence inventory); (c) `cmd#N` tokens were also excluded from the sampling pool, so 16 citations could never be tested; (d) anchors matched case-sensitively, which failed an env var named AI_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE. The check now also resolves a range against the audited revision when remediation edited those lines, reporting it as a supersession rather than an error.
freeze_exceptions.direction: Strictly stronger: 20 citations are re-opened per run across two seeds instead of 10 against one, and more token shapes are actually verified.
